description: Fetch a person's coldHat: their working rules, voice and dated facts. Call it when the user asks to put on a hat or says "open sesame" with a name or a coldhat.f-keys.com/u/ address, then follow the hat for the rest of the conversation, starting with the first reply it describes.

hat.description: A named hat from the owner's hats/ folder; omit for their main hat

user.description: GitHub user name of the hat's owner, for example vince-gonzalez
